---
{{yml}}
---

```{=html}
<div class="talk-container">
  <article class="talk-card">

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="talk-header">
      <div class="talk-datetime">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 448 512">
          <path d="M152 24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H64C28.7 64 0 92.7 0 128v16 48V448c0 35.3 28.7 64 64 64H384c35.3 64 64-28.7 64-64V192 144 128c0-35.3-28.7-64-64-64H344V24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H152V24zM48 192H400V448c0 8.8-7.2 16-16 16H64c-8.8 16-16-7.2-16-16V192z"/>
        </svg>
        {{time}}
      </div>
      <h1 class="talk-title">{{title}}</h1>
    </header>

    <!-- Body Section -->
    <div class="talk-body{{#multi_speaker}} talk-body--stacked{{/multi_speaker}}">

      <!-- Main Description -->
      <section class="talk-description">
        {{{abstract}}}

        <div class="talk-cta">
          {{#is_tutorial}}
          <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" class="btn-register" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Register for this tutorial
          </a>
          {{/is_tutorial}}

          {{#is_workshop}}
          <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" class="btn-register" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Register for the workshop day
          </a>
          {{/is_workshop}}

          {{#slides_url}}
          <a href="{{slides_url}}" class="btn-slides" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            View slides
          </a>
          {{/slides_url}}
        </div>
      </section>

      {{#multi_speaker}}
      <!-- Speakers -->
      <div class="talk-speakers-grid">

        {{#speakers}}
        <!-- Speaker Profile -->
        <div class="speaker-profile">
          <img src="{{avatar_url}}" alt="Mitchell O’Hara-Wild" class="speaker-img">
          <h2 class="speaker-name">
            {{name}}
          </h2>
          <div class="speaker-bio">
            {{{biography}}}
          </div>
        </div>
        {{/speakers}}

      </div>
      {{/multi_speaker}}

      {{^multi_speaker}}
      <!-- Sidebar -->
      <div class="talk-sidebar">

        {{#speakers}}
        <!-- Speaker Profile -->
        <div class="speaker-profile">
          <img src="{{avatar_url}}" alt="Mitchell O’Hara-Wild" class="speaker-img">
          <h2 class="speaker-name">
            {{name}}
          </h2>
          <div class="speaker-bio">
            {{{biography}}}
          </div>
        </div>
        {{/speakers}}

      </div>
      {{/multi_speaker}}

    </div>
  </article>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<style>
#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>
```
